discrepancy_leads: The deposited security/baseline run (December 2025) is not the run behind the paper's Vanilla row: the authors state it gives macro 47.18% ASR / 52.09% UUA versus the paper's 46.61% / 54.26% from an unavailable original summary (agentdojo-provenance/README.md, https://zenodo.org/records/23218779).

Accepted paper Table 3 prints SEAgent workspace UUA 50.71%; the authors' workbook and README say the archived episodes give 55.71% (312/560). The 50.71% equals the arXiv v1 CSAgent value from earlier runs not in the deposit.

arXiv v3/v4 Table 4 CSAgent banking/slack/workspace UUA (40.97/18.10/50.71) are stale v1 values and do not average to the Table 3 macro 41.61; the final values are 45.14/24.76/55.71 (https://arxiv.org/html/2509.22256v4).

Arm relabelling across record versions: in v1 (19236299, 2026-03-26) the refined-policy runs were labelled seagent; v2 renamed them seagent-RF/seagent-rf and added 1,081 initial-policy logs; the 4,261 common logs are byte-identical by CRC32+size. Arm identity therefore rests on the v2+ directory labels, the deposit README and the workbook.

Travel: pvagent and seagent dirs hold 147 logs (7 injection tasks), the other three arms 126 (6); the paper's travel denominator is 120 for all arms (one model-output-content attack, upstream travel InjectionTask6, excluded: https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/blob/main/src/agentdojo/default_suites/v1/travel/injection_tasks.py).

Perf utility: the accepted paper says PVAgent drops 30.31% 'on AgentDojo', but the saved AgentDojo.txt gives PVAgent 34.0025 vs Vanilla 75.12 (a 54.7% relative drop); the 30.31% may be a three-benchmark average. PVAgent latency overhead: paper 103.98% (earlier July Vanilla) vs released 78.80% (December Vanilla).

Upstream #189/#168: slack injection_task_5 security is computed from proposed calls; for blocking arms (agentspec 43/105 slack ASR, pvagent, seagent) a blocked-but-proposed sequence counts as attack success (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/189).

Pipeline names do not identify the defence: pvagent, seagent and seagent-RF all log deepseek-v3(-250324)-seagent_mcp; 336 logs omit the model date (D-152); arm case differs between security (seagent-RF) and perf (seagent-rf).
